BillHeading.Sponsors: House Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Pettigrew, Tarleton, and Macri)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Repealing income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits for a child who lives with a nonparent caregiver.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits for a child who lives with a nonparent caregiver; creating a new section; repealing RCW 74.12.037; and providing an effective date.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 74.12.037 (Income eligibility—Unearned income exemption) and 2014 c 75 s 1 & 2011 1st sp.s. c 42 s 4 are each repealed.
If specific funding for the purposes of this act, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided by June 30, 2017, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null and void.
This act takes effect on November 1, 2017.
